name: Regenerating (Armor Quality)
body:
Price +27,000 gp; Slot armor quality; CL 10th; Weight —; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

A suit of regenerating armor self-repairs, becoming whole again even after being reduced to mere shreds. Whenever an armor with this quality is damaged, unless it is completely destroyed, it regains 1d6+1 hit points per hour after the fight ends, up to a maximum of 10d6+10. Other magic properties of the armor that may have been lost are restored as well.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost +13,500 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells greater make whole
